scope: Development check using processed spectra and existing phase labels, not observer-time inference
target_objects: 22 nearby identities from the exposed aging-rate table
matching: Mean-subtracted normalized dot product at fixed rest wavelengths; best phase per independent template object, median phase of five highest-scoring objects
coverage: First/last nonzero support must enclose full 4000-7000 window; same spectra in both windows
exclusion: All spectra from the target object removed before matching
slope_summary: Unweighted recovered-phase versus labeled-phase slope per target with >=3 epochs and >=15 days span
limitations: Not SNID replication; no noise weighting, phase-label recalibration, uncertainty coverage, or raw flux inference
